subject: ems-sp
description: Economic & Management Sciences Senior Phase (Grades 7–9). CAPS-aligned. One subject, three strands (The Economy, Financial Literacy, Entrepreneurship). All skills open once the grade is selected (gate NONE). Procedural accounting 'recording' skills are flagged deferred_recording until a later authoring pass.
